صفحة 28Reading — Let’s talkتحدّث معى

معلّمة وطبيب — teacher and doctor
💬 Let’s talk
1What does your father do?
2What does your mother do?

صفحة 29Reading Comprehension — A dialogueحوار بين Sarah و Ann

Sarah What does your father do, Ann?
Ann My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital.
Sarah What about your mother?
Ann My mum is a teacher. She works at a school.
Sarah My father is a policeman. He protects people. He works at the police station. My mother is a nurse. She helps doctors.

استمع إلى الحوار كاملًا

صفحة 301 — Choose and complete · 2 — Where do they work?اختر وأكمل

1 — Choose and complete.

1 a — Ann’s father is a ……… (teacher – doctor). He works in a ……… (school – hospital).
doctor … hospital
2 b — The ……… (policeman – nurse) protects people in the city.
policeman
3 c — Sarah’s mother is a ……… (teacher – nurse) but Ann’s mother is a ……… (teacher – nurse).
nurse … teacher

2 — Where do they work?

4 a — A teacher works in a ……… .
school
5 b — A nurse and a doctor work in a ……… .
hospital
6 c — A policeman works in a ……… .
police station

صفحة 33Writing — Write about jobsاكتب عن المهن

مدرسة وقسم شرطة ومستشفى فى المدينة
Important Note — وسّع الجملة بإضافة تفصيلة عن كل مهنة. مثال: My father is a doctor. He takes care of sick people.
7 1 — My father is ………
My father is a doctor. He takes care of sick people. He works in a hospital.
8 2 — My mother is ………
My mother is a teacher. She teaches children. She works at a school.
9 3 — My uncle is ………
My uncle is a policeman. He protects people. He works at the police station.
